title: Delivery Head & Senior Techno-Functional Lead
description: # Open Positions – Ivy Mobility **Permanent Roles | Delivery Head & Senior Techno-Functional Lead** ## About Ivy Mobility Ivy Mobility is a global enterprise SaaS company serving the FMCG and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industries. Its cloud-based solutions support retail execution, direct store delivery, distributor management, sales force automation, and Route-to-Market (RTM) operations. The company helps consumer goods businesses improve customer experience, increase revenue, and enhance field-force productivity through enterprise CRM and distribution solutions. ## Position 1: Delivery Head – DMS, SFA & RTM ### Position Details - **Experience:** 18–24 years maximum; target experience 18–20 years - **CTC:** ₹50–60 LPA maximum - **Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time - **Industry:** FMCG / CPG / Retail Technology / Enterprise SaaS - **Domain:** Distributor Management System (DMS), Sales Force Automation (SFA), Route-to-Market (RTM) - **Location:** As per business requirement ### Role Overview Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise technology solutions across DMS, SFA, and RTM. Manage large-scale, multi-client delivery portfolios, implementation excellence, customer relationships, and global delivery teams. ### Key Responsibilities - Own end-to-end delivery across multiple client engagements, ensuring timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business objectives are met. - Lead implementations, rollouts, upgrades, integrations, and transformation programs across DMS, SFA, and RTM platforms. - Establish delivery governance, project management standards, risk management frameworks, and performance metrics. - Provide strategic direction on DMS, SFA, and RTM solutions within the FMCG/CPG ecosystem. - Build relationships with CXOs, business heads, and technology leaders; manage critical delivery escalations. - Lead project managers, program managers, delivery managers, and cross-functional implementation teams. - Own delivery budgets, profitability, margins, resource utilization, and cost optimization. - Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams on RFPs, solution estimation, delivery planning, and transition to execution. - Monitor delivery KPIs, customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, and financial performance. - Drive operational excellence, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement. ### Required Skills & Qualifications - Extensive experience in enterprise software delivery, program management, implementation, or professional services. - Strong domain expertise in DMS, SFA, and RTM, preferably in FMCG/CPG or retail technology. - Proven track record of leading large, complex, multi-client implementation and transformation programs. - Strong understanding of distributor operations, order management, inventory, secondary sales, trade promotions, field sales execution, and route planning. - Experience managing geographically distributed teams and senior customer stakeholders. - Ownership of delivery governance, project financials, resource planning, and customer escalations. - Strong collaboration with Product, Engineering, Sales, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success teams. - Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and strategic decision-making skills. ### Preferred Qualifications - Enterprise SaaS products and cloud-based platforms. - ERP integrations, including SAP and other enterprise applications. - Global delivery models and international client engagements. - PMP, PgMP, Agile, or equivalent program management certifications. ### Key Success Measures - On-time and within-budget project delivery. - Customer satisfaction, retention, and executive stakeholder relationships. - Improved delivery margins, resource utilization, and operational efficiency. - Successful DMS, SFA, and RTM implementations and rollouts. - Reduced delivery escalations and improved service quality. - Strong leadership pipeline and high-performing delivery teams. --- ## Position 2: Senior Techno-Functional Lead – DMS, RTM & CPG ### Position Details - **Experience:** 12–16 years maximum; target experience 12–15 years - **CTC:** ₹35–40 LPA maximum - **Employment Type:** Permanent - **Company:** Ivy Mobility - **Location:** Open to suitable candidates - **Domain:** FMCG / CPG, DMS, SFA, RTM ### Role Overview Bridge business requirements and technical implementation by leading solution design, complex customer engagements, and collaboration with product, engineering, QA, and implementation teams. The ideal candidate combines strong FMCG domain knowledge, technical understanding, and enterprise solution delivery leadership. ### Key Responsibilities **1. FMCG / CPG Domain Expertise** - Lead business process analysis across FMCG sales, distribution, trade promotions, and retail execution. - Understand primary and secondary sales, distributor operations, inventory, schemes, claims, and returns. - Define and optimize RTM strategies, distributor networks, territory coverage, and sales execution processes. - Advise customers on digital transformation across sales and distribution. **2. Distributor Management System (DMS)** - Lead functional solution design and implementation of DMS platforms for enterprise FMCG customers. - Define workflows for distributor onboarding, order management, inventory, invoicing, claims, returns, and reconciliation. - Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications. - Oversee distributor integrations, master-data migration, configuration, UAT, and go-live. - Resolve complex functional issues and guide root-cause analysis. **3. Route-to-Market (RTM)** - Lead solution design for RTM, SFA, van sales, retail execution, and field-sales processes. - Define territory management, outlet segmentation, beat planning, distributor coverage, and sales productivity workflows. - Analyze distribution effectiveness and recommend improvements using operational data and business KPIs. **4. Techno-Functional Solution Architecture** - Lead requirement discovery, fit-gap analysis, solution architecture, and functional design. - Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, solution design documents, user stories, and process workflows. - Work with APIs, web services, database structures, SQL queries, and third-party integrations. - Evaluate integration approaches, data mapping, system dependencies, and technical feasibility. - Guide customization, configuration, enhancements, and release planning. **5. Program Delivery & Leadership** - Lead workstreams across solution design, implementation, integration, testing, and deployment. - Manage customer stakeholders, scope, risks, dependencies, timelines, and change requests. - Drive SIT, UAT, defect resolution, production readiness, and post-go-live stabilization. - Mentor techno-functional consultants, business analysts, and implementation teams. - Manage customer escalations and ensure delivery commitments and customer satisfaction. **6. Stakeholder & Product Collaboration** - Act as the primary functional and technical contact for complex customer requirements. - Conduct executive workshops, solution presentations, and design reviews. - Collaborate with product management on customer-driven product enhancements. - Support presales activities, effort estimation, solution proposals, and technical demonstrations when required. ### Required Skills & Qualifications - 12–16 years of experience in FMCG/CPG technology, enterprise software, DMS, SFA, or RTM solutions. - Strong hands-on knowledge of FMCG sales, distribution, and retail execution. - Experience leading enterprise DMS/SFA implementations or complex techno-functional programs. - Strong understanding of business process modeling, solution design, and system integration. - Working knowledge of SQL, APIs, web services, data mapping, and enterprise application architecture. - Experience in requirements management, functional testing, UAT, and production support. - Strong customer-facing, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. - Proven ability to lead teams and manage cross-functional initiatives. ### Preferred Qualifications - Experience delivering solutions for large, multi-country FMCG/CPG customers. - Exposure to enterprise SaaS platforms and cloud-based implementations. - Knowledge of ERP integration, trade promotion management, distributor systems, and sales analytics. - Experience with Agile/Scrum, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. - Experience in presales, solution consulting, and customer transformation programs. ### Key Competencies - FMCG/CPG domain leadership. - DMS, SFA, and RTM solution expertise. - Techno-functional solution design. - Enterprise integration and technical analysis. - Customer and stakeholder management. - Program delivery and team leadership. - Strategic problem-solving and continuous improvement. --- ## Candidate Sourcing Guidelines - These are **permanent positions with Ivy Mobility**. - Prioritize serious candidates who have relevant FMCG/CPG domain expertise and DMS/RTM implementation experience. - **Delivery Head:** Maximum 18–24 years of experience; CTC up to ₹50–60 LPA. - **Senior Techno-Functional Lead:** Maximum 12–16 years of experience; CTC up to ₹35–40 LPA. - Submit **2–3 relevant CVs every day**. - Ensure candidates are genuinely interested in the opportunity and aligned with the role, domain, experience, and compensation expectations. - All profiles will undergo further validation before client submission.
